We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Shanghai Pudong district prosecutor: On May 10, 2015, defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, i.e., he had already transferred ownership, but he concealed that fact and, via a middleman, signed a transfer agreement with victim Wei for 550,000 RMB, and defrauded Wei of 480,000 RMB, used to repay personal debts. He was caught Dec 12, 2016, confessed, returned 50,000 RMB. Victim forgave and requested leniency.

So the conduct: He used deception (concealing that the house had already been sold) to obtain money from victim. This is fraud (诈骗). The list includes "诈骗". Also possibly "侵占"? Actually they used false deposit and took money. They labeled both theft and misappropriation. But here, the defendant sells a house he doesn't own (or already sold) and obtains money. That's classic fraud (诈骗). Not theft because he didn't take property directly; he obtained money by deception. So charge: 诈骗.
